VAISHNAVI KATKAR

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Financial Analyst

Results-driven Financial Operations Analyst with 4+ years of experience within financial markets and OTC derivatives operations, supporting critical post-trade activities in fast- paced, high-volume environments. Strong understanding of trade lifecycle management, operational risk, controls, and regulatory requirements, with a consistent focus on accuracy, risk mitigation, and timely execution. Experienced in partnering with internal stakeholders, clients, and counterparties to resolve operational issues, strengthen processes, and maintain effective controls. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex operational challenges, identify process improvement opportunities, and contribute to a strong control environment. Recognized for analytical thinking, attention to detail, effective stakeholder management, and a commitment to operational excellence.

SKILLS

OTC Derivatives Operations

Trade Affirmation & Confirmation

Trade Settlement

Equity Settlements

Cash & Position Reconciliation

TRI-Resolve Platform

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

FINANCIAL OPERATIONS ANALYST 10/2024 to 01/2026 Citco Shared Services India Pvt. Ltd

Managed affirmation and confirmation of a wide range of OTC derivative products,

including complex swap structures, ensuring accurate trade capture and effective risk mitigation.

Managed cash flow processing (CAM) within defined timelines, ensuring zero cutoff

breaches and seamless fund availability.

Monitored and executed time-sensitive cash movements in high-volume environments

while minimizing operational risk and maintaining accuracy.

Oversaw timely settlement of cash flows for equity and OTC trades in bilateral markets,

ensuring compliance with counterparty agreements.

Performed portfolio reconciliations using TRI-Resolve, maintaining high trade-matching

accuracy and minimizing breaks.

Acted as a liaison between counterparties and internal stakeholders to investigate and

resolve trade discrepancies and support seamless post-trade operations.

Managed end-to-end client wire payment processing through the CITCO Treasury platform, including SWIFT MT103, MT202 and MT101 and ISO 20022 pacs.008 and pacs.009 transactions.

Executed bulk wire setups to support high-volume transactions while maintaining

operational accuracy and regulatory compliance

Maintained and updated Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) across multiple

currencies to support seamless transaction processing.

Prepared End-of-Day (EOD) reports summarizing transactions, balances, and

discrepancies for management review and decision-making.

● Recognized as Employee of the Month for achieving the highest wire volumes and

consistently contributing to operational excellence.

Validated SSIs and settlement instructions before trade release to minimize

settlement failures.

Prepared and reviewed daily settlement and exception reports for operational

oversight.

Managed the end-to-end trade lifecycle from trade capture and enrichment through

confirmation/affirmation, settlement, reconciliation and exception resolution, ensuring accurate and timely processing within market and client-specific cut-offs.

Supported month-end closing activities by reviewing outstanding trades, settlement

exceptions, cash balances and reconciliation breaks

Managed end-to-end equity trade settlement lifecycle covering trade capture, confirmation/affirmation, settlement instruction validation, settlement and post- settlement reconciliation.

Processed equity buy/sell transactions across relevant markets, ensuring timely

settlement within market cut-off timelines.

SENIOR ASSOCIATE 04/2021 to 07/2024 State Street Service Private Limited

Executed trade processing and settlement for multiple management companies across

purchases, redemptions, exchanges, transfers, OTC, and ETF trades.

Authorized and released trades to market while ensuring accuracy, adherence to

operational controls, and compliance with settlement timelines.

Managed end-to-end trade settlement activities, including FOP/DVP follow-ups, AML

validation, and resolution of failed trades.

Set up multi-currency payments using SWIFT MT54x messages for T+1 and future value

dates in line with market cutoffs.

Performed daily cash and position reconciliations, investigated breaks, and resolved

discrepancies within defined reconciliation windows.

Prepared and maintained Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and conducted quality

checks to support consistent operational processes.

Managed client and counterparty communications to investigate and resolve

operational queries efficiently.

Trained junior associates on new project activities and independently executed task

migration with no escalations while following established best practices.

Received Spot Awards on two occasions for outstanding commitment, initiative, and

contributions to process growth.

Recognized for high speed and accuracy in reconciliation processes, supporting timely

and error-free delivery.

EDUCATION

University of Mumbai Master of Commerce, Accounting And Finance, 05/2023 M.L.Dahanukar College of Commerce Bachelor of Commerce, 04/2020

CERTIFICATION AND TRAINING

Investment Banking Operations Professional — Giofab Education (Pursuing) ● Advanced Excel, Microsoft Word, Outlook & PowerPoint ● Certified Tally ERP 9.0 ● Typewriting — 30 WPM, A Grade

LANGUAGES

Marathi English Hindi

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
EXPERIENCE
FINANCIAL OPERATIONS ANALYST 10/2024 to 01/2026 Citco Shared Services India Pvt. Ltd
Managed affirmation and confirmation of a wide range of OTC derivative products,
including complex swap structures, ensuring accurate trade capture and effective risk mitigation.
Managed cash flow processing (CAM) within defined timelines, ensuring zero cutoff
breaches and seamless fund availability.
Monitored and executed time-sensitive cash movements in high-volume environments
while minimizing operational risk and maintaining accuracy.
Oversaw timely settlement of cash flows for equity and OTC trades in bilateral markets,
ensuring compliance with counterparty agreements.
Performed portfolio reconciliations using TRI-Resolve, maintaining high trade-matching
accuracy and minimizing breaks.
Acted as a liaison between counterparties and internal stakeholders to investigate and
resolve trade discrepancies and support seamless post-trade operations.
Managed end-to-end client wire payment processing through the CITCO Treasury platform, including SWIFT MT103, MT202 and MT101 and ISO 20022 pacs.008 and pacs.009 transactions.
Executed bulk wire setups to support high-volume transactions while maintaining
operational accuracy and regulatory compliance
Maintained and updated Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) across multiple
currencies to support seamless transaction processing.
Prepared End-of-Day (EOD) reports summarizing transactions, balances, and
discrepancies for management review and decision-making.
● Recognized as Employee of the Month for achieving the highest wire volumes and
consistently contributing to operational excellence.
Validated SSIs and settlement instructions before trade release to minimize
settlement failures.
Prepared and reviewed daily settlement and exception reports for operational
oversight.
Managed the end-to-end trade lifecycle from trade capture and enrichment through
confirmation/affirmation, settlement, reconciliation and exception resolution, ensuring accurate and timely processing within market and client-specific cut-offs.
Supported month-end closing activities by reviewing outstanding trades, settlement
exceptions, cash balances and reconciliation breaks
Managed end-to-end equity trade settlement lifecycle covering trade capture, confirmation/affirmation, settlement instruction validation, settlement and post- settlement reconciliation.
Processed equity buy/sell transactions across relevant markets, ensuring timely
settlement within market cut-off timelines.
SENIOR ASSOCIATE 04/2021 to 07/2024 State Street Service Private Limited
Executed trade processing and settlement for multiple management companies across
purchases, redemptions, exchanges, transfers, OTC, and ETF trades.
Authorized and released trades to market while ensuring accuracy, adherence to
operational controls, and compliance with settlement timelines.
Managed end-to-end trade settlement activities, including FOP/DVP follow-ups, AML
validation, and resolution of failed trades.
Set up multi-currency payments using SWIFT MT54x messages for T+1 and future value
dates in line with market cutoffs.
Performed daily cash and position reconciliations, investigated breaks, and resolved
discrepancies within defined reconciliation windows.
Prepared and maintained Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and conducted quality
checks to support consistent operational processes.
Managed client and counterparty communications to investigate and resolve
operational queries efficiently.
Trained junior associates on new project activities and independently executed task
migration with no escalations while following established best practices.
Received Spot Awards on two occasions for outstanding commitment, initiative, and
contributions to process growth.
Recognized for high speed and accuracy in reconciliation processes, supporting timely
and error-free delivery.
